description: This file contains transformation logic for converting OpenAI/bedrock embedding requests and responses to Azure AI Cohere's embedding format, including request mapping and response processing functions.

classes.name: AzureAICohereConfig
classes.description: A configuration class that provides methods to transform embedding requests and responses between formats for Azure AI and Cohere, including model mapping and response handling.

methods.name: str _map_azure_model_group(self, model: str)
methods.description: Maps a given model name to its corresponding Azure AI Cohere model group identifier.

methods.name: ImageEmbeddingRequest _transform_request_image_embeddings( self, input: List[str], optional_params: dict )
methods.description: Transforms a list of base64-encoded image strings into an ImageEmbeddingRequest object.

methods.name: Tuple[ImageEmbeddingRequest,EmbeddingCreateParams,List[int]] _transform_request( self, input: List[str], optional_params: dict, model: str )
methods.description: Transforms input text/image data and optional parameters into the appropriate embedding request objects for either image or text embeddings, and identifies indices of base64 images.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse _transform_response(self, response: EmbeddingResponse)
methods.description: Processes an EmbeddingResponse, updating usage info and model name based on additional headers.

ctags.name: _transform_request
ctags.signature: ( self, input: List[str], optional_params: dict, model: str )
